version.promotionalText: Borrow, lend and organize books with your community of readers. Inventaire.io turns your friends into one big living library.
version.description:
Welcome to Inventaire.io — the app that turns your friends into a living library!

With Inventaire.io you can:
• Build your book inventory in seconds
• Explore the libraries of your friends and the groups you belong to
• Borrow, lend and share your favorite reads
• Search for any book in a snap

Our mission: spread reading around you and give books back their power to bring people together.

Inventaire.io is the official mobile client of the free and collaborative inventaire.io project. Join a kind community of passionate readers!
version.whatsNew:
What's new in 1.3:
• A new Network tab brings your friends and groups together, with a badge when something awaits your answer
• inventaire.io groups come to the app: find a group, ask to join, invite members or start your own
• A red dot marks the groups you administer that have requests waiting for you
• Tap a book's cover to see it full screen: pinch to zoom, double-tap to fill the screen
• "Sort my books": the button now says "Save", and the app checks with you before leaving unsaved changes
• The app now opens on your Inventory
• A work's publication date is now the right one
• Fixes: a crash related to work genres, and a friend's sync that could fail
